meta.title: About Us — Japanese TCG Proxy
meta.description: Kangaroo Japan is a proxy buying service built for U.S. TCG collectors and resellers. We source Japanese Pokémon and Yu-Gi-Oh cards from Mercari, Yahoo Auctions and Amazon Japan, then inspect, consolidate and ship to the United States.

hero.title: Built for U.S. TCG collectors & resellers
hero.subtitle: We're a Japan-based proxy buying service focused on one thing: getting Japanese trading cards into the hands of U.S. collectors and resellers, with less risk and a clearer total cost.

story.title: Why we exist
story.body1: Some of the best Pokémon and Yu-Gi-Oh cards — Japanese singles, sealed booster boxes, promos and graded slabs — live on Japanese marketplaces like Mercari, Yahoo Auctions and Amazon Japan. Most of those sellers don't ship to the United States, and the listings, condition notes and seller communication are all in Japanese.
story.body2: We bridge that gap. Our team buys and bids locally in Japan, translates condition notes into clear English, can take inspection photos before anything ships, and consolidates orders into one TCG-safe parcel to the U.S. — so you can source from Japan without the language barrier or the guesswork.

sourcing.title: Real Japan sourcing
sourcing.body: On-the-ground buying from Mercari, Yahoo Auctions, Amazon Japan and more — including sellers who never ship abroad.

transparency.title: Honest, estimated costs
transparency.body: We show estimated fees up front and confirm the exact total at checkout. We never promise tax-free imports or under-declare value.

protection.title: Collector-grade care
protection.body: Seller-risk screening, optional photo inspection and TCG-safe packaging so your corners and edges arrive the way you expect.

focus.title: Made for the hobby
focus.body: We speak TCG — condition terms, grading, sealed-box risk and high-value handling — because we're built for collectors and resellers, not generic shopping.

cta.title: Start sourcing from Japan
cta.body: Browse live Japanese listings and let us handle the buying, inspection and shipping to your U.S. address.
